notes.title: Kongregate
notes.notes:
As a lot of you know, there is an older version of oO on Kongregate. I didn't mention it at the launch and I feel bad about it because I should. 

Kongregate version has low graphics, worst performance and some unresolved bugs. Its free and you can try it here: www.kongregate.com/games/targaciej/oo

This one is a way to support me and enjoy full-screen, HD experience. If anyone feels uninformed and wants a refund - just let me know!

Have a great day!
